full_known_added_suffix: ORIGINAL IMAGE FORWARDING: For every required original-resolution/native source inspection, request view_image({path, detail:"original"}) AND forward with image(result.image_url, "original"). Calling image(result.image_url) alone can resize the already opened original to high detail. Preserve original ImageContent metadata when forwarding MCP blocks. Verify actual model-visible image dimensions and decoded content hashes against the source, rather than inferring original delivery from a source-path hash, view-call request or image count. Distinguish any tool-scaled view honestly; complete required original-resolution inspection before final source signoff. This is process-only guidance, not a rules fact or grading relaxation.
